scripts.test:capability: node --test test/supervisor.test.mjs test/minio.test.mjs test/s3-provider.test.mjs test/fault-proxy.test.mjs test/local-parity.test.mjs test/managed-local-cli.test.mjs

overridesRationale: R6-SUPPLY-01. These pins remediate 14 npm advisories (9 high, 5 moderate) that had no fix at the direct dependency: alchemy@2.0.0-beta.72 IS the newest published line (dist-tags latest and next), so `npm audit fix --force` would have DOWNGRADED to the four-months-older 2.0.0-pipeline-v2-test. Overriding the transitive packages instead took the tree from 14 advisories to 0 with a byte-identical `node cli.mjs graph`. @puppeteer/browsers 3.x additionally drops extract-zip, the one package with no fixed version at any release. Full rationale, review record and the gate that enforces it: tools/ci/dependency-advisory-policy.json + tools/ci/check_npm_advisories.py.
